title: Log rotation script
prompt:
rotate.sh does not work. Rewrite it.

Usage: ./rotate.sh <logfile> [keep]

Behaviour:
- keep defaults to 3 and must be a positive integer, else print an error to
  stderr and exit 2.
- A missing operand or an unreadable logfile must print an error to stderr and
  exit 2.
- It shifts existing archives up by one: <logfile>.2 -> <logfile>.3, .1 -> .2,
  and the live file becomes <logfile>.1. Archives numbered >= keep are deleted.
- After rotation the live logfile exists and is empty, and its permissions match
  the original file.
- It must exit non-zero when any command fails, and must handle paths containing
  spaces.
- Rotation must be safe to run repeatedly.

Only rotate.sh should change.
